products.name: Workspace ONE to Intune — Windows Device Migration — Commercial
products.short_description: The repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune Windows device migration — prepare identity and enrollment, achieve profile/compliance parity, unenroll and re-enroll in controlled rings, and validate each device. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move Windows devices from Workspace ONE to Intune — re-enrolled, compliant, and unbroken

Migrating Windows endpoints off Workspace ONE means cleanly removing the old management, enrolling into Intune, and landing the same configuration, compliance, and security — without users losing access or a device ending up managed by neither (or both). This solution is the repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune Windows device migration: prepare identity and enrollment, achieve profile/compliance parity, unenroll and re-enroll in controlled rings, and validate each device before moving on.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Windows migration model, unenroll-from-Workspace-ONE / enroll-to-Intune flow (Entra join + automatic enrollment), profile and compliance parity, Conditional Access continuity, and the ringed cutover.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Windows automatic enrollment, Workspace ONE admin access, the Windows baseline/parity target, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: confirm identity/enrollment, build parity configuration in Intune, unenroll from Workspace ONE and enroll to Intune by ring, validate configuration/compliance/access per device, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Windows migration-readiness discovery, per-device enrollment/parity validation, a migration status and compliance report, safe remediation of dual/failed enrollment, and a migration-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Windows devices moved from Workspace ONE to Intune — re-enrolled with full configuration and compliance parity, access uninterrupted, none left dual- or un-managed — proven on a pilot ring before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WS1WIN-Discovery.ps1 — Workspace ONE to Intune Windows migration readiness (read-only)
    • WS1WIN-Remediation.ps1 — safely resolve dual or failed enrollment on a migrated device
    • WS1WIN-Report.ps1 — fleet migration status + compliance for Windows devices (read-only, Graph)
    • WS1WIN-Set-MigrationRingTargeting.ps1 — build/maintain the migration-ring Entra groups (Graph)
    • WS1WIN-Validation.ps1 — per-device validation of a migrated Windows device (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
